notes.title: Timeless Treasures Dev Update #1: Dual Gameplay & Ancient Egypt
notes.content:
[b]Greetings, Adventurers![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45328939/3e232118f8de40aef107a4ceb582fb8b8f1fb87a.png[/img]

It’s time for an exciting new update on Timeless Treasures! 🌟

We’ve been making great strides on our hidden object/puzzle adventure, and today we’re thrilled to share some fresh insights into the game’s mechanics, characters, and story world.

🕰️[b] Dual Gameplay Exploration[/b]
One of the most exciting features we’re considering is a dual gameplay mechanic, where you’ll switch between two roles: an on-the-ground explorer interacting directly with the environment and a strategic guide managing the tools and hints from a distance. This opens up unique puzzle possibilities that will challenge both your wits and problem-solving skills.

🎨 [b]Main Character Reveal[/b]
Take a closer look at the character concept art above! This dapper adventurer is more than meets the eye, combining charm and curiosity with a knack for uncovering the hidden. Could this be the face of a hero—or someone with secrets of their own? Share your thoughts in the comments!

🏛️ [b]A Glimpse into the Travelers Guild[/b]
What lies beyond the blurred background in the header image? That’s a sneak peek at the Travelers Guild, your central hub and mission center. This mysterious location serves as the main menu and tutorial area, where you’ll gather tools, unlock lore, and prepare for each journey through time. What secrets does the Guild hold? Stay tuned as we unveil more.

💬 [b]Share Your Ideas![/b]
We’d love to hear from you—what do you think about the dual gameplay mechanic? What historical eras or settings would you like to see? Drop your thoughts in the comments and let’s shape this adventure together.

🎮 [b]Support Our Journey[/b]
If you haven’t already, don’t forget to wishlist Timeless Treasures on Steam. Your support helps indie studios like ours bring these dreams to life.

Thank you for joining us on this incredible journey through time. Stay tuned for more updates as we unravel the mysteries of Timeless Treasures together!

💜
— Cezary Kujawa
Founder, Memobots Games

notes.title: Welcome to the Timeless Treasures Community Hub!
notes.content:
[b]Greetings, Time Travelers![/b]

Welcome to the official Steam Community Hub for [b]Timeless Treasures! [/b]🎉

We’re thrilled to have you here as we embark on this exciting journey to create a hidden object/puzzle adventure game that spans centuries and civilizations. In Timeless Treasures, you’ll visit historical eras like Ancient Egypt, Rome, and beyond to uncover hidden artifacts, solve intricate puzzles, and uncover secrets buried in time.

Here in the Community Hub, you can:
📰[b] Stay Informed:[/b] Get updates on development progress, sneak peeks, and exclusive behind-the-scenes content.
💬 [b]Join the Conversation: [/b]Share your thoughts, ideas, and feedback as we shape the game together.
🎮 [b]Wishlist and Support: [/b]Be a part of our journey by wishlisting the game—it’s the best way to help indie studios like us!

[b]A bit about us:[/b]
We’re Memobots Games, a passionate indie studio working tirelessly to bring Timeless Treasures to life. Our goal is to create a game that’s not just about finding hidden objects but also about immersing you in the stories and mysteries of the past.

This is just the beginning! In the coming weeks, we’ll be sharing exciting updates, concept art, and a sneak peek of the first teaser. Stay tuned, [b]and don’t forget to hit that Wishlist button![/b]

Thank you for joining us on this adventure through time. Your support means the world to us. 💜

Let’s make history together!
[i]— Cezary Kujawa
Founder, Memobots Games[/i]
